summary: Treat Hostex's HTTP-200 response envelope error_code (>=400) as a typed error with 429/5xx retry, instead of trusting HTTP status.
reason: Hostex returns HTTP 200 for every call and puts the real status in error_code (200=success). The generated client treated HTTP 200 as success, so application errors were silent successes and rate-limit retries never fired.
validated_outcome: Live dogfood 255/255; reads return data, real 4xx surface as non-zero exit.
